channel.description: Recent content in Book Review on Irina Travels

item.title: book review - At the edge
item.description: Not the usual travel book, but it still managed to make me dream of foreign destinations so it counts :)

item.title: Book review ~ Cockpit Confidential: Everything You Need to Know about Air Travel
item.description:
Cockpit Confidential: Everything You Need to Know About Air Travel: Questions, Answers, and Reflections by Patrick Smith

“Nobody covers the airline experience like Patrick Smith. He brings balance and clarity to a subject all too often over-hyped. And, he’s a damned good writer.” ~ Clive Irving, Conde Nast Traveler

item.title: Book review ~ The Man Who Cycled the World
item.description:
The Man Who Cycled the World by Mark Beaumont

“A fascinating tale of determination and discovery, and a gripping, emotional ride through the peaks and valleys of the mountains and the human spirit.”  ~ Dean Karnazes, ultra endurance athlete and New York Times bestselling author of Ultramarathon Man

item.title: Book review ~ Neither Here nor There: Travels in Europe
item.description:
Neither Here nor There: Travels in Europe by Bill Bryson

“A breezy and entertaining account of what it is like to be utterly at sea in a continent most of his readers will regard as familiar.” ~ Independent on Sunday

item.title: Book review ~ How to Travel the World on $50 a Day: Travel Cheaper, Longer, Smarter
item.description:
How to Travel the World on $50 a Day: Travel Cheaper, Longer, Smarter by Matt Kepnes

“Whether you’re a savvy backpacker or just dreaming of getting a passport and going overseas, Matt’s collection of easy-to-employ money-saving strategies will open your eyes to the near-infinite ways of seeing the world without busting your budget.” ~ Matt Gross, former New York Times Frugal Traveler

item.title: Travel books series
item.description: Besides actually travelling, I also spend a lot of time reading travelling books, dreaming of far away places and making plans and lists of lists of places to visit :)
